newsitem.title: UK: Five English soccer fans held in Irish riot probe.
newsitem.headline: Five English soccer fans held in Irish riot probe.

text.p: Five men were arrested on Tuesday in connection with a football riot at an England vs Ireland soccer friendly in Dublin in 1995.
Four of them appeared in court and face extradition to Ireland after Dublin issued warrants against them for rioting and violent disorder.
A spokeswoman for the National Criminal Intelligence Service (NCIS) said the men would be charged with various offences in Ireland if they are extradited.
The fifth man is due to appear in court on Wednesday.
Twenty people were injured and 40 were arrested after fighting broke out during the match in February 1995.
Trouble started shortly after the match began when some English fans hurled missiles at supporters after Ireland took an early lead in the match.
On official inquiry in Ireland ruled that the rioting was sparked off deliberately by just a few dozen English fans.
The five men are the only people expected to be extradited from Britain, the NCIS spokeswoman added.
